justification: GST-3562 part 4 (Captain GStack Minder's scope for the deletion PR, 2026-11-25, under CREW rule 15 as scoped by approval a-6ec01c09edf8): fix-checks and their grants are deleted. Deterministic no-loss replay, no paid run. lib/review-depth.ts: nextStep drops every grant branch (granted, fixChecks, chained, roundGrant, grantedStop) and the lean and full loops' last=fix-check branches; the PR round cap at FULL_PASS_CAP no longer buys a round for a grant, so a PR past two full rounds whose code changed gets one read-only full review (main's plan when no grant was passed). Those History fields and last=fix-check stay in the type as replay-only inputs that main's frozen table at 0408128 reads; gstack-review-plan refuses the flags that set them (--grant, --round-grant, --stop, --fix-checks, --last fix-check), so no run reaches those states. planReview's scoped and fix-check dispatch stays for the frozen replays. The no-loss replays (test/helpers/gst3562-replay.ts) gain kind h: a history main accepted and the branch can no longer be given, read back as main's plan. Every non-retired case keeps its earlier kind and checks: GST-967's 1,440-case grid still hashes to MAIN_PLANS with a 20, d 10, e 60 and h 480 (all 480 are last=fix-check inputs); GST-972 and GST-1350 grids add only h (384 and 1,056 per grid); the GST-3562 A lean grid across panels, prior rounds, round grants, bot review and targeted classes keeps kinds a to f on every grant-free state and reads the grant and fix-check states as h. No case outside kind h changes, no reader is dropped, and no plan dispatches a fix-check. ship/sections/review-army.md: workflow prose only. The round-grant claim sentence, the 'fix-check (3.5) comes only from an older grant' line and decision 3.5 go, because gstack-ship-receipt claim and the fix-check are gone; every reviewer brief cut from the section renders byte-identical to its pinned body (brief-bodies pins unchanged, MAIN_SECTIONS unchanged).
